areas.name: Bounds, bulk ranges and memory ownership
areas.evidence: Sampled MatchWindow and paired complete-call records; independent allocation counters
areas.disposition: Safe bounded run/search paths retained; unsafe indexing rejected. No match buffers/copies to pool, stack-allocate or fuse; strings are flat and sequential, no demonstrated indirect/prefetch bottleneck.

areas.name: Branching, compiler calls and arithmetic
areas.evidence: Tier1 native code, identical-code controls and isolated candidate launches
areas.disposition: ASCII literal loop retained; inlining/arithmetic/routing variants rejected or inconclusive. Retry recurrence cannot be reassociated; no stencil/bit-count/division kernel. Per-call modes cannot become process globals; optional runtime capability is already frozen.

areas.name: Immutable preparation and representation
areas.boundary: WildcardMatch constructor and repeated instance calls
areas.evidence: Construction/reuse measurements, bytes per call, normalized immutable pattern
areas.disposition: Fixed-size offsets/count retained; folded pattern representation rejected for copied storage and constructor cost. No hash/dictionary/frozen map; flags already packed, MatchClock already passed by ref. No large value-type copy remains.

areas.name: Concurrency and scheduling
areas.boundary: Shared immutable matcher and call-local state
areas.evidence: Source ownership inspection, parallel-reuse tests, zero matching locks or asynchronous work
areas.disposition: No shared per-match mutation, lock or I/O to optimize. Diagnostic lazy publication is outside the hot path. Internal per-call threading/batching adds scheduling to tiny sequential work; new batch API is outside this contract.

retained: Continuation retains safe ASCII literal folding with Unicode/Turkic fallback and periodic finite-timeout checks (H-017).
Bounded full-segment searches reduce sparse/near-miss star retry work without substring allocation (H-018).
Long leading question marks use one bounded input LF scan; reused instances prepare their count (H-014/H-020).
Reusable instances prepare fixed literal prefix/suffix offsets (H-016). Combined measured constructor allocation is 72 versus 64 bytes; default matching remains allocation free.
stopping: Bounded continuation ends after 19 new mechanistic candidates plus the original three hypotheses. Every relevant catalogue category has a disposition in optimization/plan.md and the areas below; no material pending candidate remains under the complete-call and proportional-change policy. Small compiler-only effects remain inconclusive and unretained. Pattern-copy/global-cache or architecture-specific redesigns lack proportional caller evidence; this does not claim all possible optimization potential is exhausted.
correctness: Continuation final Release/Debug: 213 tests each on .NET 8 and .NET 10; 216 on .NET 11. Additional .NET 9 Release: 213. New boundaries cover segment sizes/offsets, UTF-16 tails, LF consumption, ASCII/Unicode/Turkic fallback and repeated finite/infinite-timeout instances.

Every isolated candidate passed the exhaustive/seeded/case oracle suite before timing (209 or 213 tests as boundary coverage was added). The first combined test completed the formerly expensive timeout fixture within budget; its scalar IgnoreCase refinement passes, and the failure remains archived.

Final comparative package corpus has no mismatches; local 2.0.0 package verifies Standard 2.1/.NET 10/.NET 11 assemblies, README, license and adjacent symbol package. Package binaries remain outside the repository.

All 54 integrated static/reused samples per fixture allocate zero managed bytes. Original thirteen-case geometric mean time changes are -1.9% static, -2.3% reused and -0.9% construction; targeted retry/question/literal improvements are much larger. Some tiny short and repeated-star calls regress; complete charts and paired variability remain visible.
